description: Returns an INDICATIVE monthly price range (AUD, ex GST) for recurring commercial cleaning in Sydney, including any volume discount. It is not a quote: Showpiece quotes after a site inspection. Showpiece cleans from 2 visits per week. Provide area_sqm, or hours_per_week if known (more accurate). Use request_site_inspection to proceed.

area_sqm.description: Approximate cleanable floor area in square metres. Required unless hours_per_week is given.

hours_per_week.description: Total cleaning hours per week across all visits, if known. More accurate than area_sqm.

postcode.description: Australian postcode of the site, e.g. "2113".

service_time.description: Weekday service window: "day" (6am-6pm) or "evening" (after 6pm). Defaults to evening.

visits_per_week.description: How many cleaning visits per week, minimum 2 (6 and 7 include weekend visits).

name: estimate_cleaning_price
title: Indicative cleaning price
